# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 the Roman Company, phase 1 (the charter). Generated by gen_company.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-20 v6.7 phase 2 (land, the quarter, protection treaties; group cmp-company2) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-20 v6.7 phase 3 (the Company's rise and its ends; group cmp-company3) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope. The first call of the scheduler starts the books (design 3.2).
oe_cmp_init = {
    set_variable = oe_cmp_live
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_ready_m value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_stage value = 0 }
}

# BYZ scope; n = a number or value. Autonomy within 0-100 (the crown's monopoly stays 0; phase 3: no longer counted once the Company has ended, oe_cmp_end).
oe_cmp_auto_add = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
            var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2
            has_variable = oe_cmp_auto
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end }
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto add = $n$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; n. The treasury's share, at most 20 points above the charter's value (oe_cmp_share_max) and at least 0.
oe_cmp_share_add = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
            var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2
            has_variable = oe_cmp_share
            has_variable = oe_cmp_share_max
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share add = $n$ }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_share > var:oe_cmp_share_max }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share value = var:oe_cmp_share_max }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_share < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share value = 0 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; m = an opinion modifier. The partner of charter c (oe_cmp_partner 1 Genoa, 2 Venice), if it still exists, thinks so of the empire.
oe_cmp_partner_op = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_partner ?= 1 country_exists = c:GEN }
        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_partner ?= 2 country_exists = c:VEN }
        c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; amt. v6.7 fs-frontier3 (gen_frontier.py, oe_fs.13 option c: the Company as the frontier programme's merchant backer): charter b or c with a fund of at least amt, and the Company has not ended (oe_cmp_end, cmp-company3), lends amt to the treasury; the Company grows a little bolder (autonomy +2).
oe_cmp_fs_lend = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
            var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end }
            has_variable = oe_cmp_fund
            var:oe_cmp_fund >= $amt$
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = $amt$ }
        add_gold = $amt$
        oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = 2 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; amt. v6.7 fs-frontier3: the frontier line pays a yearly return or a redemption into the fund (charter b or c, also after a handover to the partner, oe_cmp_end 2; not after the Company was wound up, oe_cmp_end 3, when the frontier line voids the contract; otherwise the gold is simply spent).
oe_cmp_fs_repay = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
            var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2
            NOT = { var:oe_cmp_end ?= 3 }
            has_variable = oe_cmp_fund
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = $amt$ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; up = yes/no. The holder's mood: the burghers (b) or the partner (c), as design 3.16 writes 'burghers' satisfaction a little up or down, or the partner's opinion'. pu / pd = the partner's opinion modifier for up / down.
oe_cmp_mood = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { always = $up$ }
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
        }
        else = {
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 3 }
        if = { limit = { always = $up$ } oe_cmp_partner_op = { m = $pu$ } }
        else = { oe_cmp_partner_op = { m = $pd$ } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; h = 1, 2, 3; cap = the fund's script value. The charter is granted: holder, fund, share (and its cap), autonomy, stage 1, the month (design 3.3, 3.4).
oe_cmp_set_holder = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_holder value = $h$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund value = $cap$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share value = $share$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share0 value = $share$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share_max value = { value = $share$ add = 20 max = 100 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto value = $auto$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_stage value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_since value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_adv value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_short value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fired_1 value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_m } remove_variable = oe_cmp_c1_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_cd } remove_variable = oe_cmp_c1_cd }
}

# BYZ scope, December (design 3.6 step 1). Charter b or c, the treasury short of next January's upkeep of the posts (oe_col_upkeep): the fund advances the whole upkeep to the treasury (oe_cmp_adv), so that the colonisation line does not close a post for want of gold. A fund too small: nothing, failure code 4.
oe_cmp_dec = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_adv value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_holder var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2 oe_col_upkeep > 0 gold < oe_col_upkeep }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_col_upkeep }
            change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = oe_col_upkeep }
            add_gold = oe_col_upkeep
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_adv value = oe_col_upkeep }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 4 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January after the colonisation line (design 3.6 steps 2-6). P = oe_cmp_gross; U = oe_col_upkeep (charged by that line this month); N = P - U. Charter b, c: the fund takes P, repays the treasury U less the December advance, and pays the dividend D = N x share (N > 0; never more than the fund). Charter a: the treasury takes P (it paid U itself), D = N, and a loss is made good from the fund. A fund that cannot cover: failure code 3 and a deficit year (oe_cmp_short; phase 3 reads two in a row). Then the autonomy of the year and the clean-up (oe_cmp_adv to 0). The figures stay for the card and oe_cmp.2. Phase 2: first the bought land still held is counted (oe_cmp_count_land).
oe_cmp_year_end = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes }
        oe_cmp_count_land = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_p value = oe_cmp_gross }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_u value = oe_cmp_upkeep_now }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_n value = { value = var:oe_cmp_p subtract = var:oe_cmp_u } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_adv } } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_adv value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_short_now } remove_variable = oe_cmp_short_now }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_holder var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = var:oe_cmp_p }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_rep value = { value = var:oe_cmp_u subtract = var:oe_cmp_adv } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_rep > 0 }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_cmp_fund >= var:oe_cmp_rep }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = var:oe_cmp_rep }
                    add_gold = var:oe_cmp_rep
                }
                else = {
                    add_gold = var:oe_cmp_fund
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund value = 0 }
                    set_variable = oe_cmp_short_now
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_rep < 0 }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = var:oe_cmp_rep }
                add_gold = var:oe_cmp_rep
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_d value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_n > 0 }
                set_variable = {
                    name = oe_cmp_d
                    value = { value = var:oe_cmp_n multiply = var:oe_cmp_share divide = 100 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_cmp_d > var:oe_cmp_fund }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_d value = var:oe_cmp_fund }
                }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_d < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_d value = 0 } }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = var:oe_cmp_d }
                add_gold = var:oe_cmp_d
            }
        }
        else = {
            add_gold = var:oe_cmp_p
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_d value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_d value = var:oe_cmp_n } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_n < 0 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_rep value = { value = var:oe_cmp_n multiply = -1 } }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_cmp_fund >= var:oe_cmp_rep }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = var:oe_cmp_rep }
                    add_gold = var:oe_cmp_rep
                }
                else = {
                    add_gold = var:oe_cmp_fund
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund value = 0 }
                    set_variable = oe_cmp_short_now
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_short_now }
            change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_short add = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 3 }
            remove_variable = oe_cmp_short_now
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_short value = 0 } }
        oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = oe_cmp_auto_gain }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_adv value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_years } } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_years value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_years add = 1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Invest (action and AI; design 3.8): the treasury pays 2 months of income into the fund; b, c: the treasury's share + 5 (cap) and autonomy -5. Cooldown 24 months.
oe_cmp_do_invest = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_inv_amt }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_cmp_amt multiply = -1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = scope:oe_cmp_amt }
        oe_cmp_share_add = { n = 5 }
        oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = -5 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_inv_next value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 24 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Audit (action and AI; design 3.8): 2 authority, autonomy -15, 10 % of the fund fined and half of it to the treasury; b: burghers a little down; c: the partner oe_cmp_op_audit. Cooldown 60 months.
oe_cmp_do_audit = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_holder var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2 }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -2 }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_fine }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt2 value = oe_cmp_fine_half }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = scope:oe_cmp_amt }
        add_gold = scope:oe_cmp_amt2
        oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = -15 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 2 }
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
        }
        else = { oe_cmp_partner_op = { m = oe_cmp_op_audit } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_aud_next value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 60 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The AI does not use the actions (ai_tick = never); it rolls here (design 3.7): 30 % to invest while the fund is under 2 months and the treasury holds 8; 50 % to audit from autonomy 60.
oe_cmp_ai_year = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = yes oe_cmp_has = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_cmp_can_invest = yes var:oe_cmp_fund < oe_cmp_ai_fund_low gold >= oe_cmp_ai_gold }
            random = { chance = 30 oe_cmp_do_invest = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_cmp_can_audit = yes var:oe_cmp_auto >= 60 }
            random = { chance = 50 oe_cmp_do_audit = yes }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. The six sites of the colonisation line go on the list oe_cmp_sites (always read with a limit: the list outlives the call).
oe_cmp_list_sites = {
    location:tana = { add_to_list = oe_cmp_sites }
    location:kaffa = { add_to_list = oe_cmp_sites }
    location:trebizond = { add_to_list = oe_cmp_sites }
    location:sinop = { add_to_list = oe_cmp_sites }
    location:varna = { add_to_list = oe_cmp_sites }
    location:chilia = { add_to_list = oe_cmp_sites }
}

# BYZ scope. scope:oe_cmp_site = the site whose post has the highest level (none: no scope; the texts have a form without a place).
oe_cmp_pick_site = {
    oe_cmp_list_sites = yes
    ordered_in_list = {
        list = oe_cmp_sites
        limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
        order_by = oe_cmp_site_lv
        max = 1
        check_range_bounds = no
        save_scope_as = oe_cmp_site
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_cmp.1 (6 quiet months after it); the event takes the main-line month itself (oe_ml_take_as line 30).
oe_cmp_fire_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_ev_cd months = 6 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.1
}

}

# BYZ scope, monthly. .1 (design 3.16): the month the preconditions first hold opens the window (oe_cmp_c1_m); 8 % a month while the line is free; sure from month 24 (lock free), must from month 30. Not after a refusal's 10 years, not after two refusals.
oe_cmp_try_1 = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_cmp_has = no
            NOT = { var:oe_cmp_fired_1 ?= 2 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_cd }
            oe_cmp_can_charter = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_m } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_c1_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        }
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_e1_wait >= 30 } oe_cmp_fire_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_ev_free = yes oe_cmp_e1_wait >= 24 } oe_cmp_fire_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_ev_free = yes } random = { chance = 8 oe_cmp_fire_1 = yes } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. .2 once it is due (oe_cmp_due_2 = the month set in January): when the line may send, or regardless after 6 months.
oe_cmp_try_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_due_2 oe_cmp_has = yes }
        if = { limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes oe_cmp_due2_wait >= 6 } } oe_cmp_fire_2 = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. .3 while the January roll's mark lasts (oe_cmp_due_3, 6 months) and the line is free; dropped when its conditions no longer hold.
oe_cmp_try_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_due_3 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_cmp_e3_ok = yes } } remove_variable = oe_cmp_due_3 }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_ev_free = yes } oe_cmp_fire_3 = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. .14 (phase 2) once stage 2 has opened (oe_cmp_due_14, set in January), when the line may send.
oe_cmp_try_14 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_due_14 oe_cmp_has = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_ev_free = yes } oe_cmp_fire_14 = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. .23 (phase 3) while its conditions hold (oe_cmp_e23_ok), when the line may send.
oe_cmp_try_23 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_cmp_e23_ok = yes } if = { limit = { oe_cmp_ev_free = yes } oe_cmp_fire_23 = yes } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. .22 (phase 3) while its conditions hold (oe_cmp_e22_ok), when the line may send.

    if = { limit = { oe_cmp_e22_ok = yes } if = { limit = { oe_cmp_ev_free = yes } oe_cmp_fire_22 = yes } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. .20 (phase 3) while its conditions hold (oe_cmp_e20_ok), when the line may send.
oe_cmp_try_20 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_cmp_e20_ok = yes } if = { limit = { oe_cmp_ev_free = yes } oe_cmp_fire_20 = yes } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. At most one event (design 3.5 step 5): the first of oe_cmp_try_2, oe_cmp_try_1, oe_cmp_try_14, oe_cmp_try_23, oe_cmp_try_22, oe_cmp_try_20, oe_cmp_try_3 that has something to do; none from 1453.6.1 or while the empire is not calm (.2 waits too); none after the Company was wound up (phase 3: not even a new charter).
oe_cmp_events = {
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1453.6.1 oe_cmp_calm = yes NOT = { var:oe_cmp_end ?= 3 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_try_2_ready = yes } oe_cmp_try_2 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_try_1_ready = yes } oe_cmp_try_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_try_14_ready = yes } oe_cmp_try_14 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_try_23_ready = yes } oe_cmp_try_23 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_try_22_ready = yes } oe_cmp_try_22 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_try_20_ready = yes } oe_cmp_try_20 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_cmp_try_3_ready = yes } oe_cmp_try_3 = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January, after the colonisation line: the accounts (oe_cmp_year_end); .2 becomes due in the first January 12 months after the charter; the petition's roll (25 %, once in 10 years); the AI's roll. Phase 2: the protection fees (oe_cmp_prot_year), stage 2 (oe_cmp_stage2), the AI's rolls for land and protection (oe_cmp_ai_year2). Phase 3: stage 3 (oe_cmp_stage3), .21 to the rulers protected for ten years (oe_cmp_e21_send), the tribute of Chios (oe_cmp_chios_year).
oe_cmp_january = {
    oe_cmp_year_end = yes
    oe_cmp_prot_year = yes
    oe_cmp_stage2 = yes
    oe_cmp_stage3 = yes
    oe_cmp_e21_send = yes
    oe_cmp_chios_year = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_cmp_has = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fired_2 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_due_2 }
            oe_cmp_since_m >= 12
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_due_2 value = oe_ml_month_now }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_e3_ok = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_cd_3 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_due_3 } }
        random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_due_3 months = 6 } }
    }
    oe_cmp_ai_year = yes
    oe_cmp_ai_year2 = yes
}

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES, id 30 "cmp", last in the round: after col 16 and crm 27, whose state of the same month it reads); no hook of its own. Starts the books; counts the months with a post (up to 12); while the empire holds Constantinople: the December advance, the January accounts, the events. Without the City the company stands still (design 3.2). Phase 2: a request whose owner has not answered in 2 months lapses (oe_cmp_req_check), with or without the City. Phase 3: every January, with or without the City, the idle years (5 in a row without the City or a post wind the Company up: oe_cmp_idle_year).
oe_cmp_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_live } } oe_cmp_init = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_cmp_pts >= 1 var:oe_cmp_ready_m < 12 } change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_ready_m add = 1 } }
    oe_cmp_req_check = yes
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_cmp_idle_year = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { owns = location:constantinople }
        if = { limit = { current_month = 12 oe_cmp_has = yes } oe_cmp_dec = yes }
        if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_cmp_january = yes }
        oe_cmp_events = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January (before the accounts). oe_cmp_land_held = the bought locations (location variable oe_cmp_bought) the empire still holds.
oe_cmp_count_land = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_land_held value = 0 }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_bought }
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_land_held add = 1 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. Stage 2 opens once its conditions hold (oe_cmp_stage 2); .14 becomes due.
oe_cmp_stage2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_stage2_ok = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_stage value = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fired_14 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_due_14 value = oe_ml_month_now }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The request under way is over.
oe_cmp_req_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_kind } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_loc } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_who } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_who }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_due } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_due }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_site } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_site }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_grant } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_grant }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_ans } remove_variable = oe_cmp_ans }
}

# BYZ scope. Every location the action 置地 could ask for now goes on the list oe_cmp_cands (the sites and their neighbours; always read with a limit: the list outlives the call).
oe_cmp_list_cands = {
    location:tana = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:kaffa = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:trebizond = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:sinop = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:varna = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:chilia = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:famagusta = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:alexandria = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
    location:beirut = {
        if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
        every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = oe_cmp_cands }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_cmp_land saved (a target that passes oe_cmp_tgt_ok). OUR REQUEST (action and AI): kind 2 a quarter (a site with our level-1 post; a named grant at Caffa or Trebizond), else kind 1 land (a neighbouring site with our level-1 post of the same owner is kept for 'only a street'). The fund pays the price now (oe_cmp_req_paid); THE OWNER'S EVENT oe_cmp.11 follows. No answer in 2 months: a refusal.
oe_cmp_ask_buy = {
    scope:oe_cmp_land = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_seller } }
    oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_cmp_land = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_kind value = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_cmp_land = { oe_cmp_grant_kaffa_ok = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_grant value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_cmp_land = { oe_cmp_grant_tre_ok = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_grant value = 2 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_kind value = 1 }
        scope:oe_cmp_land = {
            random_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes owner ?= scope:oe_cmp_seller }
                save_scope_as = oe_cmp_street
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_street }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_site value = scope:oe_cmp_street }
        }
    }
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_pay value = oe_cmp_price }
    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_paid value = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_loc value = scope:oe_cmp_land }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_who value = scope:oe_cmp_seller }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_due value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 2 } }
    scope:oe_cmp_seller = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.11 }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_cmp_who saved (a ruler that passes oe_cmp_prot_new). OUR OFFER (kind 3; nothing is paid before it signs): THE RULER'S EVENT oe_cmp.13. No answer in 2 months: a refusal.
oe_cmp_ask_prot = {
    oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_kind value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_who value = scope:oe_cmp_who }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_due value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 2 } }
    scope:oe_cmp_who = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.13 }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends oe_cmp.12, the answer (must-fire: it does not wait for the main-line lock but takes it, line 30; no quiet months).
oe_cmp_fire_12 = {
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.12
}

# BYZ scope. The job that carries out the answer oe_cmp_ans (1 sold: 11; 2 a street or the quarter: 12; 3 refused, 5 protection refused, 6 no answer: 13; 4 protection signed: 14).
oe_cmp_ans_job = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_ans ?= 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 11 }
        trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_ans ?= 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 12 }
        trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_ans ?= 3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 13 }
        trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_ans ?= 4 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 14 }
        trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_ans ?= 5 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 13 }
        trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_ans ?= 6 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 13 }
        trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. A request the other side left unanswered for 2 months lapses as a refusal (answer 6, never a sale) and oe_cmp.12 tells us. An answer that oe_cmp.12 left unread for 4 more months is carried out as its first option (oe_cmp_ans_job).
oe_cmp_req_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_kind has_variable = oe_cmp_req_due }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_ans } var:oe_cmp_req_due <= oe_ml_month_now }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_ans value = 6 }
            oe_cmp_fire_12 = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_ans oe_cmp_req_late >= 4 } oe_cmp_ans_job = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_cmp_land, scope:oe_cmp_seller saved. NOT SEEN IN GAME in this direction (an AI's or a player's location to Byzantium by script; the player chose 'sell' himself). Switch LAND_FORM = 'plain' (change_location_owner). The owner changes first; only when the self-check finds Byzantium the owner are the cores moved (the seller's off, ours on), so that a failed handover leaves the seller as it was. oe_cmp_took 1 / 0; failure code 11.
oe_cmp_take_land = {
    scope:oe_cmp_land = { change_location_owner = c:BYZ }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_cmp_land = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_took value = 1 }
        scope:oe_cmp_land = {
            if = { limit = { is_core_of = scope:oe_cmp_seller } remove_core = scope:oe_cmp_seller }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = c:BYZ } } add_core = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_took value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 11 } }
}

# BYZ scope; who = a country, years. NOT SEEN IN GAME (add_truce_with between the empire and another country). Switch TRUCE = True. Self-check has_truce_with: oe_cmp_truce_ok 1 / 0; failure code 12 (only while the switch is on).
oe_cmp_truce = {
    if = {
        limit = { $who$ = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } }
        add_truce_with = { target = $who$ years = $years$ mutual = yes }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_truce_with = $who$ } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_truce_ok value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_truce_ok value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 12 } }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_cmp_who saved (a protected ruler). NOT SEEN IN GAME in this direction (an AI made the empire's tributary by script). Phase 3's oe_cmp.21 calls it (design 3.11, after ten years of protection and with the tributary ladder's oe_ttb_suzerain); phase 2 reaches it only from the test page. Switch TRIB = True; fallback: the protection treaty stays. Self-check is_subject_of: oe_cmp_trib_ok 1 / 0; failure code 13. Once a tributary, the treaty ends (its fee stops; the ladder oe_ttb takes over).
oe_cmp_make_tributary = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_cmp_who
            scope:oe_cmp_who = { is_ai = yes is_subject = no NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
        }
        scope:oe_cmp_who = { make_subject_of = { target = c:BYZ type = subject_type:tributary } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_who scope:oe_cmp_who = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_trib_ok value = 1 }
        scope:oe_cmp_who = { oe_cmp_prot_end = { why = 3 } }
        oe_cmp_prot_count = yes
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_trib_ok value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 13 } }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_cmp_land (now ours), scope:oe_cmp_seller. After a sale (design 3.10): the seller is paid the price and thinks a little worse of us; a truce of 5 years (oe_cmp_truce); the land is marked (oe_cmp_bought = the month) and counted; the next land in 60 months; the colonisation line's oe_col_found_colonia (phase 4a) makes it a colonia, marked as the Company's (oe_col_from_company, only when no other founding waits: that one would take the mark). Phase 3: the land still held is counted at once (oe_cmp_count_land; r21 saw land_n 1, land_held 0 until January).
oe_cmp_sold = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_pay value = var:oe_cmp_req_paid }
    scope:oe_cmp_seller = { add_gold = scope:oe_cmp_pay add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_sold target = c:BYZ } }
    oe_cmp_truce = { who = scope:oe_cmp_seller years = 5 }
    scope:oe_cmp_land = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_bought value = oe_ml_month_now } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_land_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_land_n value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_land_n add = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_land_next value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 60 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_last_land value = scope:oe_cmp_land }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_last_seller value = scope:oe_cmp_seller }
    scope:oe_cmp_land = { save_scope_as = oe_col_land }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_due } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_col_from_company value = 1 }
    }
    oe_col_found_colonia = yes
    oe_cmp_count_land = yes
}

# BYZ scope. oe_cmp_prot_n = the rulers under the Company's protection (country variable oe_cmp_prot).
oe_cmp_prot_count = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_prot_n value = 0 }
    every_country = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot }
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_prot_n add = 1 } }
    }
}

# Country scope (a protected ruler); why = 1 it no longer qualifies, 2 the fee went unpaid (its opinion oe_cmp_op_dropped; failure code 16), 3 it became the empire's tributary. The treaty ends and its opinion goes.
oe_cmp_prot_end = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot }
        remove_variable = oe_cmp_prot
        remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_protected target = c:BYZ }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_why value = $why$ }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_cmp_why = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_dropped target = c:BYZ }
            c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 16 } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. Each protected ruler: no longer fit (oe_cmp_prot_keep) - the treaty ends; else the Company pays the year's fee (0.5 months of OUR income) to it; a fund that cannot - the treaty ends (design 3.10). Then the count.
oe_cmp_prot_year = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_fee value = oe_cmp_prot_fee }
    every_country = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_cmp_prot_keep = yes } } oe_cmp_prot_end = { why = 1 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { c:BYZ = { oe_cmp_has = yes has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= scope:oe_cmp_fee } }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = scope:oe_cmp_fee } }
            add_gold = scope:oe_cmp_fee
        }
        else = { oe_cmp_prot_end = { why = 2 } }
    }
    oe_cmp_prot_count = yes
}

# BYZ scope, January. The AI (design 3.7): 10 % to buy - the best target (oe_cmp_ai_score) whose owner is an AI, with 4 months left in the fund; then, if no request waits, 10 % to offer protection to the likeliest ruler.
oe_cmp_ai_year2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = yes oe_cmp_stage2_on = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_cmp_can_buy = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 10
                oe_cmp_list_cands = yes
                ordered_in_list = {
                    list = oe_cmp_cands
                    limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                    order_by = oe_cmp_ai_score
                    max = 1
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land
                }
                if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_land var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_ai_need } oe_cmp_ask_buy = yes }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_cmp_can_protect = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 10
                ordered_country = {
                    limit = { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes }
                    order_by = oe_cmp_acc_prot
                    max = 1
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    save_scope_as = oe_cmp_who
                }
                if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_who } oe_cmp_ask_prot = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Stage 2 at once (the charter dated back 120 months; .14 becomes due; charter needed).
oe_cmp_test_st2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_since value = { value = oe_ml_month_now subtract = 120 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_stage value = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fired_14 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_due_14 value = oe_ml_month_now }
        }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope (stage 2 needed). The waiting request is dropped; the AI's best land target whose owner is an AI is asked for (the fund topped up to the price): its event goes to the AI owner, our answer oe_cmp.12 follows.
oe_cmp_test_buy = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes }
        oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
        set_variable = {
            name = oe_cmp_fund
            value = { value = var:oe_cmp_fund add = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = 20 } }
        }
        oe_cmp_list_cands = yes
        ordered_in_list = {
            list = oe_cmp_cands
            limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes } owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
            order_by = oe_cmp_ai_score
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_land }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_need value = oe_cmp_price }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_fund < scope:oe_cmp_need }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund value = scope:oe_cmp_need }
            }
            oe_cmp_ask_buy = yes
        }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope (stage 2 needed). The waiting request is dropped; the quarter of a site with our level-1 post whose owner is an AI is asked for (the fund topped up).

# TEST PAGE ONLY. Any country scope (the runner's: the CURRENT player, who must not be Byzantium). Byzantium asks THIS country for one of its coastal locations (not its capital; one next to a site first) and .11 comes here, so that its text and options can be read. The options take effect: 'sell' really hands the location to Byzantium (a throw-away test game only).
oe_cmp_test_e11me = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } c:BYZ = { oe_cmp_has = yes } }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { is_coastal = yes NOT = { is_capital = yes } NOT = { has_siege = yes } }
            order_by = oe_cmp_e11_score
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_land }
            c:BYZ = {
                oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
                set_variable = {
                    name = oe_cmp_fund
                    value = { value = var:oe_cmp_fund add = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = 20 } }
                }
                oe_cmp_ask_buy = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope (stage 2 needed). The waiting request is dropped; the likeliest ruler is offered protection (the fund topped up to a year's fee).
oe_cmp_test_prot = {

        oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
        set_variable = {
            name = oe_cmp_fund
            value = { value = var:oe_cmp_fund add = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = 2 } }
        }
        ordered_country = {
            limit = { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes }
            order_by = oe_cmp_acc_prot
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_cmp_who
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_who } oe_cmp_ask_prot = yes }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. .14 at once (no stage, no lock).
oe_cmp_fire_14t = {
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.14
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. PROBE of oe_cmp_take_land alone (no request, no event, nothing paid): the AI-owned land target the AI would pick first - else any coastal AI location next to one of the nine sites, not a capital - is handed to Byzantium; on success the sale's steps run (truce, mark, colonia: 'A New Colonia' pops up). CHANGES THE MAP: a throw-away test game only.
oe_cmp_test_land = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes }
        set_variable = {
            name = oe_cmp_fund
            value = { value = var:oe_cmp_fund add = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = 20 } }
        }
        oe_cmp_list_cands = yes
        ordered_in_list = {
            list = oe_cmp_cands
            limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes } owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
            order_by = oe_cmp_ai_score
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_land } }
        location:tana = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:kaffa = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:trebizond = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:sinop = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:varna = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:chilia = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:famagusta = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:alexandria = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        location:beirut = {
            every_neighbor_location = {
                limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_base = yes owner ?= { is_ai = yes } }
                add_to_list = oe_cmp_probe
            }
        }
        random_in_list = { list = oe_cmp_probe save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_land }
        scope:oe_cmp_land = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_seller } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_req_paid value = 0 }
        oe_cmp_take_land = yes
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_took ?= 1 } oe_cmp_sold = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. PROBE of oe_cmp_truce alone: a truce of 1 year with the last seller, else Genoa (not at war with us); the result goes to oe_cmp_truce_ok (and failure code 12).
oe_cmp_test_truce = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cmp_last_seller ?= { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } }
        var:oe_cmp_last_seller = { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_tw }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } }
        c:GEN = { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_tw }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_tw } oe_cmp_truce = { who = scope:oe_cmp_tw years = 1 } }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. PROBE of oe_cmp_make_tributary alone (phase 3's step): the first protected ruler becomes the empire's tributary; the result goes to oe_cmp_trib_ok (and failure code 13). CHANGES THE WORLD: a throw-away test game only.
oe_cmp_test_trib = {
    random_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot } save_scope_as = oe_cmp_who }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_who } oe_cmp_make_tributary = yes }
}

# BYZ scope, January. A merchants' or partners' company whose autonomy is at least 40 is marked (oe_cmp_grow_hit, once); stage 3 opens in the January the mark and stage 2 are both there (design 3.2).
oe_cmp_stage3 = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_cmp_has = yes
            has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
            var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end }
            has_variable = oe_cmp_auto
            var:oe_cmp_auto >= 40
        }
        set_variable = oe_cmp_grow_hit
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_cmp_has = yes
            var:oe_cmp_stage ?= 2
            has_variable = oe_cmp_grow_hit
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_stage value = 3 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. With the tributary ladder's oe_ttb_suzerain and stage 2 or later: every protected ruler that fits oe_cmp_e21_fit gets oe_cmp.21 (marked for 3 months meanwhile).
oe_cmp_e21_send = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes oe_cmp_stage2_on = yes has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain }
        every_country = {
            limit = { oe_cmp_e21_fit = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_trib_wait months = 3 }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.21
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, January. The tribute of Chios bought by .22 b: 1 month of income to the treasury while the island is still on Genoa's side; it ends when the island changes sides.
oe_cmp_chios_year = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_chios_trib }
        if = { limit = { location:chios = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } } } add_gold = oe_cmp_chios_trib_amt }
        else = { remove_variable = oe_cmp_chios_trib }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Nationalisation (the action, .23 a, job 27; design 3.11): a merchants' or partners' company that has not ended - the treasury pays the shareholders 50 % of the fund (oe_cmp_nat_paid); b: burghers a little down, c: the partner oe_cmp_op_seized; then the crown's monopoly (holder 1, share 100, autonomy 0); the farmed customs end; oe_cmp_end 1. The fund stays the Company's (now the crown's).
oe_cmp_do_nat = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_holder var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_nat_cost }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_cmp_amt multiply = -1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_nat_paid value = scope:oe_cmp_amt }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 2 }
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
        }
        else = { oe_cmp_partner_op = { m = oe_cmp_op_seized } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_holder value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share value = 100 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share0 value = 100 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share_max value = 100 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_farm } remove_variable = oe_cmp_farm }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The Company is wound up (design 3.11; oe_cmp_end 3): a waiting request is dropped (its price back to the fund first); every protection treaty ends (without the 'dropped' opinion); the crown's monopoly takes what is left of the fund into the treasury, a merchants' or partners' fund goes to its shareholders (oe_cmp_end_fund keeps the sum for the notice); the farmed customs end; the notice oe_cmp.24. From then on oe_cmp_has is false and the line stops.
oe_cmp_dissolve = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = var:oe_cmp_req_paid }
    }
    oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot } oe_cmp_prot_end = { why = 1 } }
    oe_cmp_prot_count = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end_fund value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund > 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end_fund value = var:oe_cmp_fund }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 1 } add_gold = var:oe_cmp_fund }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed } remove_country_modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_farm } remove_variable = oe_cmp_farm }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    oe_cmp_fire_24 = yes
}

# BYZ scope, every January (with or without the City). A year without Constantinople or without a single counted post adds to oe_cmp_idle, any other resets it; after 5 in a row the Company is wound up (design 3.11: five years without a post, or the City lost - the loss counted the same way, so a City retaken within five years keeps the Company).
oe_cmp_idle_year = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { owns = location:constantinople } oe_cmp_pts < 1 } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_idle } } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_idle value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_idle add = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_idle value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_idle >= 5 } oe_cmp_dissolve = yes }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope (stage 2 and a merchants' or partners' charter needed). Stage 3 at once: autonomy to at least 40, the mark oe_cmp_grow_hit.
oe_cmp_test_st3 = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_cmp_has = yes
            has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
            var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end }
            oe_cmp_stage2_on = yes
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_auto < 40 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto value = 40 } }
        set_variable = oe_cmp_grow_hit
        set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_stage value = 3 }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. Any country scope (the runner's: the CURRENT player, who must not be Byzantium). # TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The colonisation line and opinions already given are left alone. Phase 3: the ending and the marks of .21 on other countries go too (a tributary stays one).

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fired_22 } remove_variable = oe_cmp_fired_22 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_chios } remove_variable = oe_cmp_chios }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_chios_trib } remove_variable = oe_cmp_chios_trib }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } remove_variable = oe_cmp_end }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end_m } remove_variable = oe_cmp_end_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end_fund } remove_variable = oe_cmp_end_fund }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_idle } remove_variable = oe_cmp_idle }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_nat_paid } remove_variable = oe_cmp_nat_paid }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_trib_who } remove_variable = oe_cmp_trib_who }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end_test } remove_variable = oe_cmp_end_test }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_kind } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_loc } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_who } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_who }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_due } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_due }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_site } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_site }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_grant } remove_variable = oe_cmp_req_grant }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_ans } remove_variable = oe_cmp_ans }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed } remove_country_modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cmp_own_convoys } remove_country_modifier = oe_cmp_own_convoys }
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                has_variable = oe_cmp_prot
                has_variable = oe_cmp_no_cd
                has_variable = oe_cmp_trib_no
                has_variable = oe_cmp_trib_wait
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot } remove_variable = oe_cmp_prot }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_no_cd } remove_variable = oe_cmp_no_cd }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_trib_no } remove_variable = oe_cmp_trib_no }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_trib_wait } remove_variable = oe_cmp_trib_wait }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The colonisation line's posts open (its own test effect oe_col_test_open) and this line counts 12 months with a post. No post is built and the date is not changed (before 1352.1.1 .1 does not come by itself: use cmpe1).
oe_cmp_test_ready = {
    oe_col_test_open = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_live } } oe_cmp_init = yes }
    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_ready_m value = 12 }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. .1 at once (no window, no roll; only without a charter).
oe_cmp_test_e1 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_live } } oe_cmp_init = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = no }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_cd } remove_variable = oe_cmp_c1_cd }
        oe_cmp_fire_1 = yes
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The December advance and the January accounts at once (no event, no AI roll).
oe_cmp_test_year = {
    if = { limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes } oe_cmp_dec = yes oe_cmp_year_end = yes }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. Any country scope (the runner's: the current player). The sender of .2: Byzantium's accounts are closed now (the stored P, U, N, D), then .2 goes to THIS country when it is Byzantium (r21: a value the sender stores is missing when the event is fired from the console).
oe_cmp_test_send2 = {
    c:BYZ ?= { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes } oe_cmp_year_end = yes } }
    if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.2 }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Holder b or c: autonomy to at least 40, then .3 at once.
oe_cmp_test_e3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_holder var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_auto < 40 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_auto value = 40 } }
        oe_cmp_fire_3t = yes
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. .3 without the January mark.
oe_cmp_fire_3t = {
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cmp.3
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The fund + 10 months of income (charter needed).
oe_cmp_test_fund = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cmp_has = yes }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = 10 } }
    }
}

# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Autonomy + 30 (charter b or c).
oe_cmp_test_auto = {
    oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = 30 }
}
